senses.gloss:
Ulūka
a Sāṁkhya teacher, mentioned in Mahābhārata, Śānti, Kumbh. edn. 323. 26-32; by Māṭhara in his Sāṁkhyakārīkāvṛtti; an. in Tattvārthaślokavārttika.

Ulūkakapota-utpātaśānti(-prayoga)
Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 18. L. 3227 (attributed to Garga). Rajapur 778. RASB. III. 2622.

Ulūkakalpa
spelt also ullūkaº or ullūº.
Bharatpur XVI. 242. BORI. 1110 of 1886-92. 8 of 1898-99. Delhi IV. 3901. IM. 683. 4631. Jainagranthāvalī p. 364. JBhP. I. 396. Nepal II. p. 207. Peters. VI. p. 136. RASB. VIII. A. 6157.
Pt.. with Hindi transl., Moradabad, 1925. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1102.
--name of a C.. a. end of the Uḍḍāmareśvara or Uḍḍīśa Tantra; ascribed to Mahādeva Śukrācārya. Adyar Transcript 607. MT. 2949 (b) on Abhicāra, Vaśīkaraṇa etc.
--from Kalpasāgara. IM. 7580B. Oudh XII. 50.

Ulūkatantra
another name of ulUkakalpa in some mss.

Ulūkatantra
or ulUkakalpa tantra. by Govinda. Jainagranthāvalī p. 364. Peters. IV. 41.

Ulūkapakṣa
tantra. from Kalpasāgara. Oudh XII. 50. See under Ulūkakalpa.

Ulūkaśānti
prayoga. Adyar I. p. 95b. Ānandāśrama 457A (yājñika). [Page398-b]
--(Śaunakīya) MD. 3256. 3257.
--from Śāntikalpa. MT. 437.
--from the Adbhutasāgara of Ballālasena. Jodhpur 793.

Ulluṇṭhavādimukhakīlaka
jy. Pkt. in 123 verses. by Abhayacandra (Śvet.). BBRAS. 299 (ms. d. Saṁ. 1557).
